```{r setup}
library(fastMILC)
```

## Scope

`fastMILC` re-implements the continuous-time microsimulation lung-cancer model
MILC with vectorized `nhppp` sampling over a `data.table` population. This
vignette is a **scaffold placeholder**; it will grow into a walk-through of the
scalar-to-vectorized refactor as the event generators are implemented.

## Ported kernel functions

The pure MILC kernels are vectorized and validated against the archival scalars:

```{r}
milc_HT_mal(t = c(50, 60, 70), gender = "male", d = 20, smok_status = "Y")
milc_age_grp(c(38, 47, 88))
```

## Converted mortality tables

The archival cumulative-incidence tables are shipped as tidy step-hazard
`data.table`s (tabulated horizon only; upper-tail handling is a separate design
decision):

```{r}
head(other_cells)
head(lung_cells)
```
